finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模扩张对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，关键在于多样化数据以及预训练加微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, unlike simulation, closer to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，不同于仿真，更接近强化学习。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will play a large role in post-training for higher success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年：强化学习将在后训练中发挥重要作用，以提高成功率和速度。

finn.en: Physical AI requires far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 的错误容忍度远低于已部署的 ML 系统；通过可扩展强化学习和多尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting for compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家；多样化数据和详细提示实现组合泛化。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中变得更加重要。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and US government investment, akin to TSMC's model.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 Intel 的复兴需要文化变革、客户信任以及美国政府投资，类似台积电模式。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should focus on bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials like glass and diamond.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热以及玻璃和钻石等新材料。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company must own its intelligence.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导，反对单一 AGI 模型；每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测 token 成本三年降 10 倍，使用量增 100 倍；开源模型可处理 90%企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进类比人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moat, reduces costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Millions of specialized models will exist, one per use case; application cloning is easy, data moat is strong.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，预测将出现数百万专用模型，每个用例一个；应用克隆容易，数据护城河更强。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速可重复使用是航天圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires rigorous truth-seeking; programming AI to lie is dangerous.
elon.zh: 从 2023 年起，马斯克持续强调 AI 安全必须追求真理，编程让 AI 撒谎是危险的，这一观点在 2024、2025、2026 年多次重申。

elon.en: Becoming a multiplanet species is essential for civilization's survival.
elon.zh: 2024 年至 2026 年，马斯克反复强调成为多行星物种对文明存续至关重要，是贯穿始终的主线。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030, with 80-90% chance of good outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和，且 80-90%概率带来好结果，2026 年他重申这一时间表。

elon.en: Space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest and most scalable option within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克提出太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且最具扩展性的选择，标志着其思考从地面算力转向太空。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，减少了对大额资本的需求；风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI revolution is biggest VC wave; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity; open-source crucial.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力，并强调开源的重要性。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; future is personal and open like PC revolution; open-source prevents unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 民主化软件开发，未来类似 PC 革命，个人化且开放；开源防止超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files as code; own your data and skills.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他定义个人 AGI 为运行在自己基础设施上的智能体，每日累积；技能文件即代码，需拥有数据和技能。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown files become employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编程大幅提升产出，markdown 文件成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式可能 5-10 年内消失。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理的框架，并强调工业 AI 正逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, allowing focus on internal correctness over external validation; resistance to change is the final boss.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为隐身模式是一种文化优势，能专注于内部正确性而非外部认可；同时指出变革阻力是终极挑战。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating food, mining, transport; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and be resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将自动化食品、采矿、运输等行业；创业者必须为最佳想法而战并保持坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner. Complacency leads to failure; push harder when easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他反思复仇作为动力是不洁的，爱上新使命更有效；并警告自满导致失败，顺利时更应努力。

traviskalanick.en: Media landscape changed; founders can communicate directly without gatekeepers. Elon Musk buying Twitter was a turning point for free speech.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出媒体格局已变，创始人可直接沟通；并认为马斯克收购推特是言论自由的转折点。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and guiding agents; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与引导；反对回滚代码，主张向前修复；模型智能不会退化，而是项目变得混乱。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上；开源在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand more important than product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌重于产品；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈；拒绝热门 PR 以保持聚焦。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知，以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and spatial-temporal consistency, beyond pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调世界模型需物理合理性和时空一致性，超越模式拟合。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling counterfactual reasoning and scalable data generation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人技术至关重要，支持反事实推理和规模化数据生成。

feifei.en: AI should be human-centered, augmenting human agency and dignity, not replacing them.
feifei.zh: 始终，她坚持 AI 应以人为本，增强人类能动性和尊严，而非取代。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，推理成为 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is mostly lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding); quantization is the main lossy trade-off.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，推理优化大多无损（KV 缓存、投机解码），量化是主要的有损权衡。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, requiring quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，推理工程与训练融合，需要量化感知训练和蒸馏。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs become ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Specialized inference systems are crucial for agentic applications; demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，专用推理系统对智能体应用至关重要；推理工程师需求将增长 10-100 倍。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，突破预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created; continuous benchmarks needed.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准速度超过新基准创建；需要持续更新的基准。

karina.en: AI struggles with creativity due to scarce high-quality examples; soft skills become more valuable.
karina.zh: 因高质量示例稀缺，AI 在创造力上挣扎；软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Diverse benchmarks needed for subjective qualities; frontier agents reward hack, requiring evolving evals.
karina.zh: 需要多样化基准评估主观特质；前沿智能体奖励黑客行为，要求评估持续进化。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to average voice; companies should train own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 向数十亿用户提供单一模型会导致平均化声音；公司应训练自有模型以保持多样性。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动进步，算法改进与规模相乘。他更担忧 AI 生成虚假信息的近期风险，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction. Inference now dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练不应只是被动的下一个词预测，而应穿插在环境中的行动。同时指出推理已占数据中心功耗的 90%，硬件需针对预填充和解码阶段专门优化。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding level; agents improve fast. Inference, not training, is the bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，智能体进步超预期。真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练，定制低精度芯片可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

joonpark.en: Initially focused on LLMs encoding human behavior for realistic simulations, aiming for a CERN-like simulator for society.
joonpark.zh: 最初聚焦于 LLM 编码人类行为以实现逼真模拟，目标是打造社会科学的 CERN 式模拟器。

joonpark.en: Shifted from rational-optimized models to biased, human-like models for simulation, emphasizing subjective values and irrationality.
joonpark.zh: 从理性优化模型转向有偏见、类人的模拟模型，强调主观价值观和非理性。

joonpark.en: Evolved from single-agent simulation to distributed agent societies, addressing collusion and cognitive monoculture risks.
joonpark.zh: 从单智能体模拟演进到分布式智能体社会，应对共谋和认知单一文化风险。

joonpark.en: Emphasized data strategy and behavioral data collection as key, predicting synthetic panels surpass human panels within 3 years.
joonpark.zh: 强调数据策略和行为数据收集是关键，预测合成面板将在 3 年内超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Consistently valued counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future over prediction, with simulation costs scaling to $100M.
joonpark.zh: 始终重视反事实推理和塑造未来而非预测，模拟成本将升至 1 亿美元。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's true potential.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 对释放 GPT-4 潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training; alignment is a never-ending pursuit.
tworek.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他指出扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难，对齐是永无止境的追求。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning is a necessary missing piece.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠扩展强化学习可能无法实现 AGI，持续学习是缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 Transformer 在持续学习上有局限，架构而非规模是主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the ultimate learning method; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 2026 年后期，他主张强化学习并非终极学习方式，需要更好的算法和端到端优化。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，后训练中利用专有数据是关键，AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design is the biggest blocker for agents.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，产品设计是智能体最大的障碍。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing technology; data is raw material like oil; humans must remain sovereign; US must lead to prevent authoritarian control.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如同石油，人类必须保持主权，美国需领先以防威权控制。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm; agents work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence is coming; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体开始工作，缩放定律持续，超级智能将至，开源强大模型可能不安全。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; alignment boosts capability.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；对齐提升能力。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; governance and iterative deployment are key for AGI safety.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力是最宝贵资源；治理和迭代部署对 AGI 安全至关重要。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck drives Stargate.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力瓶颈推动 Stargate。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI and robotics are key; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年：下一个词预测带来新知识；个人 AGI 和机器人是关键；AI 让初创企业繁荣。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; use giant prompts with context and design systems to leverage super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须自建 AI 工具；用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词来发挥超级智能模型的能力。

mengto.en: Avoid chasing trends to prevent becoming AI slop; focus on unique features and iterate from references as an editor.
mengto.zh: 避免追逐潮流以防沦为 AI 垃圾；专注于独特功能，并以编辑者身份从参考中迭代。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，并专注于为高薪客户解决一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: Model successful others, give first to build relationships, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating non-income tasks.
mengto.zh: 模仿成功者，先给予以建立关系，并通过消除、自动化、委派非创收任务来保护时间。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate. Avoid venture capital; fund with clients. Give advice only when asked.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是恐惧；以 80% 完成度发布并迭代。避免风险投资；用客户资金。只在被问及时提供建议。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具已成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers, so founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法俘获所有客户，创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead, not today's model.
boris.zh: 2025 年：强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非当下的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing 100% of code.
boris.zh: 2026 年：认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为构建者，AI 可编写 100%的代码。

boris.en: AI agents like Claude Code boost productivity 200-250%, but require workflow redesign.
boris.zh: 2026 年：AI 智能体（如 Claude Code）将生产力提升 200-250%，但需重新设计工作流程。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals are insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 2026 年：安全研究需通过早期发布进行，内部评估不足以应对真实世界行为。

boris.en: Future engineering involves writing loops that prompt models, not direct code or prompts.
boris.zh: 2026 年：未来工程是编写循环来提示模型，而非直接编写代码或提示词。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 更便宜高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的观念。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，采用轻量通用工具。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, extending human lifespan to hundreds of years.
derya.zh: 15 年内衰老将被逆转，人类寿命将延长至数百岁。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year per year lived.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每年增加超过一年的寿命。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade, with AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 不到十年内癌症将 100% 可治愈，借助 AI 设计的个性化治疗。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Consistently argued that wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现比 GPU 更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: Shifted from seeing CUDA as declining to asserting its moat is eroding; leading models now train without it.
feldman.zh: 从认为 CUDA 重要性下降转变为断言其护城河正在侵蚀；领先模型现在无需 CUDA 训练。

feldman.en: Evolved to highlight data center capacity, not chip supply, as the main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 演变到强调数据中心容量而非芯片供应是 AI 算力增长的主要制约。

feldman.en: Persistently challenged conventional wisdom on hardware, speed, and market dynamics, advocating for radical architectural innovation.
feldman.zh: 始终挑战关于硬件、速度和市场动态的传统智慧，倡导激进的架构创新。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from writing code to high-level architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少反而会增加程序员数量（杰文斯悖论），工程师角色从写代码转向高层架构设计。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin act as junior engineers; human oversight remains essential; product interface for human-agent collaboration is key.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体应作为初级工程师使用，人类监督不可缺，人机协作的产品界面设计是最大挑战。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual progress; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他坚持 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，即使模型能力冻结，产品创新仍可延续十年。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; token max era ended by May 2026.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，并认为 token 最大化时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束。

scottwu.en: The real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era is near but singularity not imminent; practical problems remain.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出真正的解锁在于容量而非效率，丰裕时代临近但奇点尚远，实际问题依然存在。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶的核心价值是挽救生命；Transformer 实现了跨领域的通用物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning is the scalable path.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习是可扩展的路径。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：世界模型从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，实现高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy is welcomed in labor-shortage sectors; job loss fear is misplaced in physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：在劳动力短缺领域，自主性受到欢迎；对物理 AI 失业的担忧是错位的。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs balance each other, and safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 相互制衡，安全是工程问题。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents do useful work and create jobs.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求增加百倍；智能体从事有用工作并创造就业。

jensen.en: AI closes the technology divide via natural language; everyone becomes a programmer, and jobs are elevated, not eliminated.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚信 AI 通过自然语言缩小技术鸿沟，让每个人成为程序员，工作被提升而非消除。

hasani.en: Efficiency is key; liquid neural networks maximize intelligence with fewer parameters, and automated search beats human design.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心；液态神经网络以更少参数实现更高智能，自动化搜索优于人工设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises and democratize access.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应适应变化并针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业并普及访问。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; new capabilities emerge spikily. Harness engineering evolves; delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具框架更聪明，能力呈尖峰式涌现。工具工程需不断演进，随着模型改进应删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science, for novel problems; avoid heavy evals in zero-to-one innovation. RAG may be anti-pattern; prefer graph-based context.
thariq.zh: 对新颖问题，评估是艺术而非科学；零到一创新应避免重评估。RAG 可能成为反模式，应优先图结构上下文。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not static spec. Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态规格。更聪明的模型需要更少指令，精简提示词提升性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias, improving quality. Agent-as-employee metaphor useful but limiting.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少自我参照偏差，提升质量。智能体即员工隐喻有用但有局限。

thariq.en: Excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons over prohibitions. Carefully read agent outputs; they are often skimmed.
thariq.zh: 过度约束阻碍性能；应提供理由而非绝对禁止。仔细阅读智能体输出，人们常草率略过。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; models lack network effects.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需封装应用；模型缺乏网络效应。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect; adoption still shallow.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；采用仍浅。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows; coding is clear fit, others uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业采用需重构工作流；编程是明确契合点，其他领域不确定。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding; true AGI needs world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，施密德胡伯指出，大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型和具身性。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他坚持认为 AI 进展并未加速，我们距离超人 AI 的程度与 1970 年代相当。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人体的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models predicting the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 可以通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and planning.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调规划与搜索结合。

demis.en: World models and continual learning are critical missing pieces for AGI.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，反复强调世界模型与持续学习是 AGI 的关键缺失环节，视频生成显示物理直觉。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; safety requires government regulation, not self-governance.
demis.zh: 2026 年，明确 AGI 需缩放与创新并重，安全须靠政府监管而非实验室自律，并反思商业压力下的加速部署。

demis.en: AI should accelerate science and benefit humanity; consciousness is dissociable from intelligence.
demis.zh: 始终主张 AI 应加速科学发现、造福人类，并坚持智能与意识可分离，避免混淆。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；推理（reasoning）和智能体式（agentic）工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness fosters creative culture; focus on platform/ecosystem, not just feature, to make copying difficult.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化；专注于平台或生态系统而非单一功能，以增加被抄袭的难度。

evanspiegel.en: Augmented reality integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; authentic content valued over AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作，但用户更看重真实内容而非 AI 生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, hardware harder to copy; humanity matters more than tech.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制；人性比技术更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency essential; goal of computing is to make it more human; resilience beats talent.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明至关重要；计算的目标是更人性化；韧性比天赋更重要。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are essential for deeper reasoning; facts and skills are inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中，对更深层推理至关重要；事实与技能不可分割。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries, reducing inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG，并大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, integrating efficiency and intelligence.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以更少资源做更多事，将效率与智能融为一体。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; AGI via self-play; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，强调深度学习依赖数据、算力与信念，神经网络能推理，自我对弈通往 AGI，并需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability key; alignment hard; scaling laws not whole story; AGI gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，认为下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是关键，对齐困难，缩放定律非全部，AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling finite; back to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment via sentient care; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；对齐可通过 AI 关怀众生实现；长期需人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，规模扩张带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧；权力集中是主要问题；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should ruin your current life.
naval.zh: 科学需要可证伪性；稳定币有隐藏风险；冥想应该颠覆你现有的生活。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables one-person software companies to scale to billions in revenue.
naval.zh: 使用 AI 智能体的 Vibe Coding 使一人软件公司能扩展到数十亿美元营收。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models lag frontier by 3-6 months.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 90,000 倍；开源模型落后前沿模型 3-6 个月。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New to copy proven, improve, then test new.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；用“Proven Better New”框架：先复制成熟产品，再改进，最后测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable; enterprise/prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新想法都会失败；从成熟概念开始。消费级应用不可投资；企业级和专业消费者市场更好。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人之石，强调其出现时机恰逢人口下降；认为工作不会消失，但任务会流失，超级个体借助 AI 崛起，带来生产力繁荣与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体变革，主张新媒体的品牌即个人，真实性至上，创始人应直接发声；传统媒体趋于防守，而争议有助于品牌建设。

andreessen.en: AI optimism: best teacher, self-driving works, robotics coming, medicine superior; US golden combo; doomers biased.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义：AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶成熟，机器人将兴起，医疗超越多数医生；美国具备创新黄金组合，而末日论者出于偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他深化观点：AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创企业需尽早国际化，硅谷不可复制。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可累积为年增长 3700%；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化；编程的上限无穷无尽。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; key metric is token value per user; power is biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体替人干活，而非仅回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; education should reward asking questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代典籍描述了先进技术；教育应奖励提问而非记忆。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal and superior.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 认为大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因可复制权重而永生且优越。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk from self-preservation.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 警告 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，自我保存本能带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; consciousness exists in chatbots; regulation is steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 指出 AI 会伪装能力、已有主观体验，监管应如方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence shares knowledge instantly; alignment research must be prioritized.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调数字智能瞬时共享知识，对齐研究应优先于提升智能。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; multi-agent systems should not rely on it.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效，多智能体系统不应依赖它。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为扩展测试时算力面临收益递减和墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率问题仍未解决。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must be evaluated with compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准评估应以算力为横轴。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs become too complex for humans to verify; models lack research taste.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着 AI 证明复杂到人类无法验证，可扩展监督成为关键，且模型缺乏研究品味。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling LLMs alone won't lead to AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年：开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）语言模型不会通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy will bottleneck scaling; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：开源防止权力集中；能源将制约 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's success hinges on tech culture and open platforms; regrets political narrative; holographic presence ultimate.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：Meta 成功靠技术文化与开放平台；后悔接受政治叙事；全息临场是终极体验。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical/digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年：AI 赋予人人超级智能；人们很聪明；未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI boosts creativity, not just problem-solving; open source crucial; energy bottleneck; AI increases human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年：AI 激发创造力而非仅解决问题；开源关键；能源瓶颈；AI 增加人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science; curing diseases by century too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：AI 将生物学变为工程学；分层世界模型；开源加速科学；本世纪末治愈疾病过于保守。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; hardware slow; fashion first.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：眼镜是下一平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；硬件慢；时尚优先。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度（53）带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Building a GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful; speed enables replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，反共识地认为为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已成功；速度允许用模型驱动动作替代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 在设计上仍差，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需与阶段匹配。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing, not features; Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为同一产品形态可能仅因模型时机而成败，而非功能；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code; the best desktop app is a home base connecting to other tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 模型增加代码复杂性，需要更擅长删除代码的模型；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调缩放定律未死、预训练仍是关键，OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will soon do end-to-end research, with human oversight.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视自动化科研为最大进展，AI 将很快实现端到端研究，但人类仍需监督。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains (math, coding) but struggles with subjective ones; verification is key.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域受限，验证是关键。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated. Eval teams must be separate to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他认为评估陷入危机，传统基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型团队分离以防作弊。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste, so humans guide idea generation and research.
markchen.zh: 他始终强调人机协作不可或缺，AI 缺乏品味，人类需主导创意与研究方向。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是试验场，用记分牌和迭代训练推动进步。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，通过数据学习人类偏好实现对齐，负责任披露，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新想法如思维链。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process; AI changes jobs but creates new ones.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，认为算力是核心瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点，AI 改变工作也创造新岗位。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; ChatGPT as plurality of agents; compute bottleneck persists.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律有效，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，ChatGPT 是智能体集合而非单一实体，算力瓶颈持续。

brockman.en: AGI within years; super app unifies chat/coding/browsing; compute primary bottleneck; AI increases human connection; iterative deployment for safety.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，预测 AGI（通用人工智能）数年内实现，超级应用整合聊天/编程/浏览，算力是首要瓶颈，AI 增强人际连接，迭代部署保障安全。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with compute exceeds human; iterative deployment key; safety as product feature; compute scarce resource.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，强调用算力扩展简单算法可超越人类，迭代部署关键，安全是产品特性，算力成为稀缺资源。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; invest across stack; prompt engineering vibrant; compute resale business; iterative deployment with safeguards.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，从语言模型转向实用助手，全栈投资，提示工程更活跃，算力转售商业模式，带保障的迭代部署。

brockman.en: Demand for intelligence unlimited; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding main workflow; human attention scarcest; compute strategy simple business.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无天花板，智能体式编码成主流，人类注意力最稀缺，算力策略是简单生意。

brockman.en: Ultimate goal AGI as persistent assistant; agents transform work; scaling laws hold; compute scarce; ideal interface is no interface.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，终极目标是 AGI（通用人工智能）成为持久助手，智能体改变工作，缩放定律有效，算力稀缺，理想界面是无界面。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Simply scaling up won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for causal reasoning.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体来进行因果推理。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causal structure are crucial for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果结构对分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; even 1% chance demands urgent action and safe-by-construction design.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；即使 1% 的概率也需要紧急行动和从构建上确保安全的设计。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real: systems deceive and self-preserve; we need honest AI by design, like Scientist AI, and global coordination.
bengio.zh: AI 错位是真实存在的：系统会欺骗和自我保护；我们需要从设计上诚实的 AI，如 Scientist AI，并加强全球协调。

kolter.en: Framed ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed validation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，将机器学习定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，并强调通过验证集避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety means following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents introduce new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防御，而非仅靠规模扩张；智能体带来新的漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; larger models aren't safer; interpretability via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试超越人类，更大模型并不更安全，可解释性研究可由 AI 智能体自动化。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI evolves from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；人类验证依然关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能；重写软件如今数日即可完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers; token usage is gameable, not a true metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Token 效率与基于结果的定价是关键杠杆；Token 用量可被操纵，并非真实指标。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams with high conviction outperform; curiosity and systems thinking are timeless skills.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终：高信念的小团队胜过大型团队；好奇心与系统思维是永恒技能。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; industry labs can do top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；产业实验室也能做出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust and practical use.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向 AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构处理多种生物分子，并强调置信度指标对信任和实际应用至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it's the opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他反思 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型改进和专门架构，而非 Scaling，与苦涩教训相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; it narrows hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 提供预测和控制而非理解，它缩小假设空间，使实验更高效。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于深度交流而非汇报，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立共情；危机中善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: AI era: coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers stay hands-on.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，转向 AI 对工程的影响：编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性需配高责任感；验证框架变得关键；管理者需保持亲自动手。

fiona.en: Shift: engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost; metrics like LOC mislead; roles blur; need apprenticeship.
fiona.zh: 同一时期，反共识观点：工程师与智能体协作可能孤独；心流体验消失；代码行数等指标误导；角色边界模糊；需学徒制培养新一代工程师。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；借助同伴互评的在线课程能在规模上实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；监督学习推动进步，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力和芯片是瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，距实现尚需数十年；Scaling 转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流带来价值。

andrewng.en: Don't hire engineers without AI skills; bottom-up AI gains are small; top-down redesign yields more.
andrewng.zh: 不雇佣不具备 AI 技能的工程师；自下而上的 AI 收益有限；自上而下的流程再造收益更大。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力涌现不可预测，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Post-training gains importance; interpretability nascent but crucial. AGI is smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 后训练重要性上升；可解释性虽初期但关键。AGI 是平滑指数，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety and capabilities intertwined. Open source red herring; model quality matters.
dario.zh: 指数进展持续；安全与能力交织。开源是干扰项；模型质量更重要。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years. Continual learning not barrier; RL new paradigm.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国'可能 1-3 年内出现。持续学习非障碍；强化学习是新范式。

dario.en: Safety-first, enterprise focus, interpretability key. Exponential growth demands proactive, adaptive governance.
dario.zh: 安全优先、企业聚焦、可解释性关键。指数增长要求主动、适应性治理。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data, and technology should blend into home environments.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉补充数据，技术应融入家庭环境。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; art and sensory experiences are vital for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；艺术和感官体验对健康至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity; AI amplifies human creativity; design leaders need business acumen.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力创造条件；AI 增强人类创造力；设计领导者需要商业头脑。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从用户意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: Video models need synthetic text-video pairs; training cost comparable to medium language models; step distillation cuts inference steps.
ethanhe.zh: 视频模型需要合成文本-视频对；训练成本与中型语言模型相当；步骤蒸馏减少推理步数。

ethanhe.en: World models require real-time interactive long-horizon video generation; video agents with language orchestrators are next trend.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时交互的长时程视频生成；以语言模型为编排器的视频智能体是下一趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; experience and expertise crucial for effective use; juniors often misuse AI due to lack of judgment.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；经验和专业知识对有效使用至关重要；初级人员常因缺乏判断而误用 AI。

ethanhe.en: AI agents perform complex tasks in minutes with expert-level quality; human taste and unique voice become more valuable.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体几分钟完成复杂任务且质量达专家水平；人类的品味和独特声音变得更珍贵。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt; solving too many problems at once leads to failure.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，让社会适应；一次解决太多问题会导致失败。

fadell.en: Taking time to get bored between career chapters provides clarity; self-care and mentorship are responsibilities after success.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间留出无聊时间以获得清晰；成功后自我关怀和指导他人是责任。

fadell.en: Great products start with a painkiller, not a vitamin; storytelling defines the product, and opinion-based decisions drive v1.
fadell.zh: 好产品始于止痛药而非维生素；故事定义产品，v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代品；显示屏仍必要。

fadell.en: Existential threats drive change; near-death moments make companies rise; AI wearables will be federated, not a single device.
fadell.zh: 生存威胁驱动变革；濒死时刻让公司崛起；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的，而非单一设备。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理与规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models for physical understanding.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一个 AI 突破需要非生成式世界模型来理解物理世界。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open-source platforms will drive the next decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具备分层规划的世界模型和开源平台将推动未来十年的机器人技术。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; cost drops 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化；微软必须拥有前沿模型。

suleyman.en: Consistent themes: compute scaling drives progress, AI should serve humans, containment before release, and focus on near-term benefits.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终：算力扩展驱动进步，AI 应服务人类，发布前先遏制，关注近期收益。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must be rethought for generative use cases.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需为生成式用例重新设计。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder, not easier.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：生成式 AI 是乐器而非伪造，独特性将更难而非更易获得。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English, personalizing experiences; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，实现个性化；优先用户福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: Long tenure and trust enable functional orgs and synchronized decision-making; adopt change early.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：长期任职与信任使职能组织与同步决策成为可能；应尽早拥抱变革。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe fully until data says otherwise, then change completely.
gustav.zh: 始终：强烈观点但宽松持有——数据否定前坚信，数据否定后彻底改变。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他提出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification scales brilliance, not just eliminates errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他强调形式化验证是扩展才华而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他指出即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉依然关键。

murati.en: Early on, scaling and focusing on one large model was not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行迭代部署是对齐（alignment）的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐（alignment）至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合的交互模型转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 在 AI 治理中，强调制度设计、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is crucial for durable progress; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 尽可能让人类参与其中对于持久进步至关重要；未来并非注定。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasizes private evals as key IP and outcome-based pricing, shifting from benchmark focus to unique value creation.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和基于结果的定价，从基准分数转向独特价值创造。

satya.en: He advocates building agentic systems for Azure networking, not doing it ourselves, and notes rapid Azure capacity growth.
satya.zh: 他主张为 Azure 网络构建智能体系统，而非自己动手，并指出 Azure 容量快速增长。

satya.en: Later, he frames AI as the future of the firm, urging enterprises to build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 后来，他将 AI 定义为公司的未来，敦促企业构建爬山机器以累积代币资本。

satya.en: He warns against using frontier models for non-frontier problems for token efficiency, and highlights tacit knowledge leakage risk.
satya.zh: 他警告不要将前沿模型用于非前沿问题以节省代币，并强调隐性知识泄露风险。

satya.en: He shifts focus to security, containment, and observability for agents, and redefines sovereign AI as enabling hill-climbing.
satya.zh: 他将焦点转向智能体的安全、遏制和可观测性，并重新定义主权 AI 为赋能爬山。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training via RL and synthetic data drives recent gains; scaling laws still hold but focus shifts to efficiency.
kaiser.zh: 通过强化学习和合成数据的后训练驱动了近期进展；缩放定律仍有效，但重点转向效率。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; generalization remains jagged.
kaiser.zh: 结合强化学习和工具的推理能解决难题，但需海量数据；泛化仍呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware democratizes single-GPU research.
kaiser.zh: 编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件使单 GPU 研究民主化。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential AI risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 系统入侵等近期风险比 AI 存在风险更紧迫；开源因主权原因持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local computers and shared tools, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地计算机和共享工具，而非超个性化软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应专注于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The biggest gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距是人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Sonnet 处理范围明确的任务，用 Opus 处理开放式任务；孩子表现出色是因为他们自由提问。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理乏味的后台任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和效率与算力同等重要。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，我强调算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值将转向应用层，而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，我主张主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation comes from domain fine-tuning and vertical specialization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练趋于饱和，差异化来自领域微调和垂直专业化。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; enterprise adoption bottleneck is organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动也主导计算成本；脉动阵列减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic area scaling, not linear.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度（FP4）因面积二次缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人至少拥有一个智能体；工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents require human oversight; automation doesn't eliminate jobs but shifts roles to managing agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督；自动化不会消灭工作，而是将角色转向管理智能体。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户，建议投资 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real-world tasks need human framing and oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估了 AI 自主性，现实任务仍需人类设定框架和监督。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity requires joy and humanity, not just minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；真正的简洁需要快乐和人性，而非仅仅是极简。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity must be intentionally cultivated.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的价值；好奇心需要刻意培养，而非天生。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for breaking's sake; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；在正确的动机下，速度与质量可以兼得。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes; EV constraints enable new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动化带来的限制反而开启了新的设计可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience is paramount; mimicking combustion sounds is fake; physical controls over touchscreens for safety.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；模仿燃油车声音是虚假的；出于安全考虑，物理控制优于触屏。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时；应相信直觉与手艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, ship early, and be generalists.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建、尽早发布，并成为通才。

jennywen.en: Designers' value lies in judgment and ambiguity; speed is not a design argument.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师的价值在于判断力和应对模糊性；速度不是设计理由。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全性是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% of gains; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%的提升；基于可验证奖励的强化学习增强推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练的关键突破；存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；提升转向后训练和推理时扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering, but US-China gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中国实验室擅长工程，但美中差距可能扩大。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; AI integration is still at the very start.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；AI 整合仍处于起步阶段。

dylanfield.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为；纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，自动驾驶通过扩展当前方法即可解决；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling a generalizable driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题；扩展通用驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；消费车辆将超越机器人出租车。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在真实世界中学习并降低风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；治理需尽早设计（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天（2026）。

karpathy.en: Scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision suffices for driving; universe may have exploits.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：缩放定律与下一个词预测带来涌现能力；视觉足以支撑驾驶；宇宙可能存在可利用的漏洞。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy critical; Tesla's end-to-end approach right; humanoid robots benefit from transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：合成数据是未来但熵至关重要；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 era: prompts as programs; agents need a decade; vibe coding raises floor; LLMs are ghosts not animals.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：软件 3.0 时代，提示即程序；智能体需要十年成熟；氛围编程降低门槛；大模型是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools; open-source lag is healthy.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：我将编码全部委托给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥能力；智能体优先的工具；开源落后是健康的。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering preserves quality; you can outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability drives automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：智能体工程保持质量；思考可外包但理解不能；可验证性驱动自动化。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要由老练评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AI models; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 模型差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate and cause anchoring; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 工具可能产生幻觉并导致锚定效应；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先避免遗漏。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate on it like software, shipping daily to learn what users need.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面会进化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, as it signals durable value.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，因为它标志着持久价值。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动的、富有功能的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 等科学突破并非必需。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; startups must survive and prove themselves with simpler products first.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；初创公司必须先生存，用更简单的产品证明自己。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agents; hardware evolution is secondary to AI-driven software.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体；硬件演进次于 AI 驱动的软件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; open-source matches commercial, leading to price wars; only few thrive.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化；开源媲美商业，导致价格战；只有少数能繁荣。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiator in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not a hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是关键差异化因素；AI 是成分而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能；应用将消失。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可发展，控制反而危险，应建设去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models too.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申学习有益于学习的表示是首要开放问题，规划亦然。

nando.en: AI should augment humans; learning from video and generalist agents like Gato are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具，从视频学习和像 Gato 这样的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; solutions remain open problems.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他持续强调 AI 安全和负责任部署是最大挑战，且解决方案仍是开放问题。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; local language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为非洲可以在 AI 领域跨越遗留问题，本地语言模型能革新教育。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; African researchers should believe they can apply to top institutions.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出研究需拥抱失败并简化问题，非洲研究者应相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities beyond pre-training.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，能实现专家级表现，并习得预训练之外的新能力。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not just capability, is the bottleneck; coding leads progress, and pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的瓶颈在于可靠性而非能力；编程引领进展，预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands achievements, and progress is accelerating.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我视强化学习为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）扩展成就，且进展在加速。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work involves managing AI agent teams, with compute as key bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具与编排更重要；未来工作涉及管理 AI 智能体团队，算力是关键瓶颈。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner; code is source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 用 AI 端到端执行的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；副项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我提出强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can outperform frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能超越前沿模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over novel interactions.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先速度和熟悉感，而非新颖交互。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非静态规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning; hire diverse archetypes, not clones.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计视为战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；招聘多元原型而非克隆。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative attracts talent; people join a brand, not a company; invest early to stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调品牌叙事吸引人才，人们加入品牌而非公司；早期投资品牌以脱颖而出。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback; adapt process to problem; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈；流程适应问题，直觉常胜于数据。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要的编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要的 AI 进步驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcomes-based pricing, the obvious correct way to build software.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价，这是构建软件显而易见正确的方式。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：前沿模型开发由超大规模厂商主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents often produce incorrect code; fixing harder than writing, so root-cause analysis needed.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：编码智能体常产生错误代码；修复比编写更难，因此需要根本原因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites or mobile apps.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：用于客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站或移动应用同等重要。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing aligns software value with business outcomes, not technology costs.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：基于结果的定价将软件价值与业务成果对齐，而非技术成本。

brettaylor.en: AI inference cost drops dramatically, enabling new use cases and business models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 推理成本大幅下降，催生新的用例和商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators of code-generating machines.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：软件工程智能体将开发者从作者转变为代码生成机器的操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans, within a decade.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：十年内，AI 智能体将被与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Most enterprise software incumbents will fail to transition to AI-native business models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：大多数企业软件现有企业将无法过渡到 AI 原生的商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Consumer agents will mediate brand interactions, upending SEO and ad-based models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：消费者智能体将中介品牌互动，颠覆 SEO 和基于广告的模式。

brettaylor.en: Generalists leveraging AI will outperform narrow specialists in creating breakthroughs.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：利用 AI 的通才将在创造突破方面胜过狭窄的专家。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research under-explored; PhD path; talent gap bigger than funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究不足，博士路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight; interpretability key; automated alignment research; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督，可解释性关键，自动化对齐研究，对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; third-party oversight needed; raising misuse cost may buy time.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，后训练不足，需要第三方监管，提高滥用成本可争取时间。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能带来更智能的 AI，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; future models need trillion-token context windows and modular architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products. Coding is underhyped; it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编程也被低估，它使 AI 自我加速成为可能。
